title: Bentness and sign-valuedness of the dual
statement: Let $n$ be even, and let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ be bent and sign-valued, meaning $|f(x)|=1$ for every $x$. Then its dual function, obtained by multiplying each Walsh Fourier coefficient of $f$ by $2^{n/2}$, is sign-valued and bent.
